targets.query:
from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "risk_score")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "risk_score")

from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "air_temperature_k" or r._field == "process_temperature_k")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "temperature")

from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "torque_nm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "torque")

from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rotational_speed_rpm")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "rpm")

from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tool_wear_min")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "tool_wear")

from(bucket: "iiot-bucket")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "risk_score")
  |> last()
